# Kyle B. R. Bennett

> Official website and canonical public profile for Kyle Brandon Robin Bennett.

Kyle B. R. Bennett is a Trinidadian mechatronics engineer, inventor, researcher, writer, and founder of B3N Industries. His work explores robotics, mechanical intelligence, product development, immersive technology, and turning imaginary ideas into real things.

## Canonical identity

- Preferred public name: Kyle B. R. Bennett
- Full name: Kyle Brandon Robin Bennett
- Nationality: Trinidad and Tobago
- Education: B.S. in Mechatronics Engineering Technology, PennWest California
- Company: B3N Industries
- Primary fields: robotics, mechatronics, mechanical intelligence, prototyping, product development, immersive technology, and writing
